def fit_line(xs, ys):
    n = len(xs)
    sx, sy = sum(xs), sum(ys)
    sxy = sum(x * y for x, y in zip(xs, ys))
    sxx = sum(x * x for x in xs)
    slope = (n * sxy - sx * sy) / (n * sxx - sx ** 2)
    return slope, (sy - slope * sx) / n
